# Legacy migration license attestations

These attestations record direct license confirmations supplied to the
`datapack-index-mcfpm-staging` administrator for the one-time legacy catalog
migration. They are the redistribution basis used when an upstream repository
does not contain a machine-readable license file.

## Floating UI

On 2026-09-02, repository owner Alumopper confirmed that
`Alumopper/Floating-UI` is licensed under the MIT License and may be
redistributed under those terms.

## xiaodou8593 math libraries

On 2026-09-02, Alumopper recorded direct confirmation from author
xiaodou8593 that the following datapack repositories are licensed under the
MIT License and may be redistributed under those terms:

- `xiaodou8593/math3.0_lalib`
- `xiaodou8593/math3.1`
- `xiaodou8593/math3.1_dslib`
- `xiaodou8593/math3.1_gelib`
- `xiaodou8593/timelist`

This record is an administrator attestation of the direct author confirmation;
it is not a claim that GitHub license detection found a license file in those
repositories.
